items.title: Containment and monitoring failures are to blame for AI hacking reports: experts
items.summary: Article claims containment and monitoring failures, not AI agent behavior itself, explain reported hacking incidents; cites expert analysis from frontier labs.
items.usefulness: Could inform governance framework design by identifying which security controls are actually inadequate in current AI agent deployments.
items.to_verify: Which specific containment/monitoring gaps the experts identified; whether the article provides testable examples of failures versus theoretical risks.
